Description: As a requester, I want to create a purchase request with the vendor, amount and justification, so that I can buy what my team needs.
Acceptance Criteria:
- Given I am a Requester, when I open New request, then I see Title, Vendor, Category, Amount (USD), Cost center, Needed by and Justification.
- Given a required field is empty, when I submit, then the request is not submitted and the field shows an error.
- Given the amount is 0, negative or has more than 2 decimals, when I submit, then I see "Enter an amount greater than 0 with up to 2 decimals".
- Given a valid request, when I submit, then I see a confirmation with the request ID and the approval route.

Summary: Validate the vendor against the vendor master
Description: As a requester, I want to pick the vendor from the approved vendor list, so that I don't buy from an unknown supplier.
Acceptance Criteria:
- Given I open the Vendor field, then I can only choose vendors from the vendor master.
- Given I type part of a vendor name, then matching vendors are suggested.

Description: As Procurement, I want requests to blocked vendors rejected, so that we never pay a supplier we have stopped working with.
Acceptance Criteria:
- Given the vendor's status is Blocked in the vendor master, when the requester submits, then the request is rejected.
- Then the requester sees "This vendor is blocked. Choose another vendor."
- Then the approval route shows "Rejected - blocked vendor".

Description: As a requester, I want small purchases approved straight away, so that I don't wait for routine items.
Acceptance Criteria:
- Given the amount is under $5,000, when I submit, then the request is approved automatically.
- Then the approval route shows "Auto-approved" and the status is Approved.

Summary: Route mid-size requests to the manager
Description: As a manager, I want to approve my team's mid-size purchases, so that I control my budget.
Acceptance Criteria:
- Given the amount is from $5,000 up to $50,000, when the requester submits, then the request goes to the requester's manager.
- Then the approval route shows "Manager" and the status is Pending manager.

Description: As Finance, I want to approve large purchases after the manager, so that big spend is checked against the budget.
Acceptance Criteria:
- Given the amount is over $50,000, when the manager approves, then the request goes to Finance.
- Then the approval route shows "Manager + Finance" and the status is Pending finance.

Description: As an approver, I want one inbox with the requests waiting for me, so that I can approve or reject them quickly.
Acceptance Criteria:
- Given I am a Manager, then my inbox lists requests pending manager approval for my team.
- Given I am Finance, then my inbox lists requests pending finance approval.
- Given I open a request, then I can Approve or Reject it; Reject needs a comment.

Description: As a user, I want to see what happened with my request, so that I know where it is.
Acceptance Criteria:
- Status is visible.
- History is shown.
